correctness.rationale: The claim is finite and exactly checkable. The verifier reconstructs all \(64\) binary words, uses the definition of asymmetric distance, exactly enumerates the compatibility graph's maximum cliques, obtains maximum size \(12\) with exactly \(30\) maxima, independently generates all \(15\) perfect matchings with both transversal-cube bipartition classes, and verifies equality of those \(30\) constructions with the complete maximum-clique list. It also exhausts all \(720\) coordinate permutations and obtains one orbit of size \(30\). The direct proof in RESULT.md verifies every constructed code has minimum asymmetric distance \(2\).

value.rationale: The finding is structurally motivated by a published optimal construction at the smallest even length where the cited ternary concatenation yields a 12-word optimum. It proves that this construction is not merely one optimum: every optimum is the same up to coordinate permutation. The matching-plus-transversal description explains the full extremal set, yields the exact labeled count \(30\), and exposes the stabilizer order \(24\). This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary slice or a recomputation of the already-known size.
